messages:
marta: Customer Nexify reporting that several project admins suddenly see a 403 in the console after an Okta group rename earlier today. Root error shown to them: "You do not have permission to access this project (403)". They say it affected ~6 users, all were previously project-admins.

samir: Do we have the Okta SCIM payload they saw? Sounds like group id changed vs display name only. If the externalGroupId changed we could have orphaned mappings. :thinking_face:

marta: I asked for screenshots and an export from their IdP team. They attached an Okta SCIM diff that shows old group externalId = `okta-g-123` and new one = `okta-g-789`. Display name changed from "nexify-eng-admins" to "nexify-platform-admins" at 09:12 UTC.

idm-bot: Automated log: detected SCIM group PATCH -> group.externalId changed for org:nexify at 1699996345. Floating role-mapping validation failed: mapped_role_id=proj-admin-001 not found for new externalId.

elaine: That matches the symptoms: role bindings are keyed to externalGroupId. When externalId flips, our role mappings don't match and users lose derived roles until a resync/rebind.

jake: Customer is asking for a quick workaround — they need at least one admin back to kick off a resync. Any safe manual fix?

samir: Short-term: we can rebind the new externalId to the existing role mapping in the control plane. I'll need the org id + new externalId. Longer term we should accept group display name + fallback or store historical externalIds for a grace period.

marta: Org id is `org_9x_nexify`, new externalId `okta-g-789`. Can ops do the rebind?

samir: I can run a targeted rebind but need approval. Command I'll run:

```bash
# confirm mapping
redwood-admin mappings list --org org_9x_nexify | grep proj-admin-001
# bind new external id -> existing role
redwood-admin mappings bind --org org_9x_nexify --external-id okta-g-789 --role proj-admin-001
```

samir: Will take ~90s. I'll also trigger a SCIM resync and a role-propagation job to the project.

marta: Customer gave go-ahead. Please post the step results here so I can confirm with them. :white_check_mark:

samir: Ran the bind and resync at 1699999360. Logs: "bind success" -> mapping proj-admin-001 -> okta-g-789. Propagation job queued (job_id=prop-7712).

idm-bot: Propagation job prop-7712 status update: started -> 1699999375; applied role to 6 users -> 1699999405; completed -> 1699999418.

marta: Customer confirmed they can now access the project and can see admin actions again. They asked what caused it and whether they need to do anything when renaming groups.

elaine: Short answer: renaming is fine, but some IdPs change the external id on a display-name rename. We should add to docs: when renaming Okta groups, ensure externalId is preserved or rebind in RBAC. We'll also add a note to the SCIM troubleshooting page.

jake: I'll follow up with Nexify and recommend preserving externalId or scheduling a rebind window. Also offering to run a post-rename check for them.

marta: Closing loop: issue resolved for now. Follow-ups: (1) docs update (elaine), (2) consider graceful mapping fallback (samir), (3) run a weekly job to detect group externalId churn and auto-notify org admins (product/infra).

samir: Filed infra ticket INF-2893 for fallback/historical-ids.

elaine: I'll add a small KB entry and add an FAQ line to setup docs.

jake: Marking customer follow-up scheduled for tomorrow. :calendar:

marta: Thanks all. Keeping thread open until KB live. :thumbsup:
